verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a first-party llms.txt is live (HTTP 200) on AMD's ROCm documentation site, which is where the RX 9070 XT's AI/ML support (PyTorch, JAX, vLLM on gfx1201) is documented. It also notes that per-project files exist across the split docs, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this GPU. missing for 10: verified depth and content of the llms.txt and per-project files beyond the truncated probe, hands-on or independent corroboration of agents using it, and coverage of the main amd.com product page, which was unreachable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
